versions.changelog:
- Added Raydium support to the list of supported platforms in documentation.
- No code changes—documentation update only.

Initial release of ForgeX CLI for on-chain market making and wallet management.

- Launch tokens, bundle buys, and manage wallets from a single CLI—no programming required.
- Supports Sonic SVM, Solana, Pump.fun, Jito Bundle, and OpenClaw Native platforms.
- Streamlined commands for wallet generation, group management, backup/restore, and vanity addresses.
- Buy/sell/sniper trading and batch execution with Jito bundles; all commands support dry-run mode.
- Built-in market making tools: volume bots, turnover/cycling between wallet groups, and more.
- Secure storage and handling for multiple wallets, with CSV and encrypted JSON import/export.
